action.description: What the target agent is being asked to do. Free text or a controlled vocabulary defined per run.

timeout_ms.description: Use only when 'to' is kind=llm. Machine agents operate on millisecond timers.

expected_response_by.description: Use only when 'to' is kind=human. Human agents don't operate on millisecond timers; missed deadlines are a judgment call, not an automatic failure.

human_summary.description: One to three lines a human relay agent can read without parsing the rest of the payload, so the message is self-contained if separated from its header.
